<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **9** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/lint/src/index.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**7** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/data-modeling/field-types.mdx`  _(via FieldType (symbol, a top-level const object), subFields (literal, a string literal in SUB_FIELD_KEYS))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/validation-rules.mdx`  _(via FieldType (symbol, a top-level const object), subFields (literal, a string literal in SUB_FIELD_KEYS))_
- `content/docs/getting-started/quick-reference.mdx`  _(via FieldType (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx`  _(via FieldType (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx`  _(via FieldType (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/widget-contract.mdx`  _(via FieldType (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx`  _(via FieldType (symbol, a top-level const object))_

⛔ **2** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx`  _(via FieldType (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-5.mdx`  _(via FieldType (symbol, a top-level const object))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/lint/src/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **3** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **144** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f9a1e93f437ac1d9c20042912acfa39bb434d938` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `24c83b09e7f1bf36ba708083d9e46b8ef27f6aba` — the merge of head `87ff1c798a28e947a56d27e5c3f2d0e33bc34866` into base `f9a1e93f437ac1d9c20042912acfa39bb434d938`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 24c83b09e7f1bf36ba708083d9e46b8ef27f6aba && git checkout 24c83b09e7f1bf36ba708083d9e46b8ef27f6aba
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin f9a1e93f437ac1d9c20042912acfa39bb434d938 87ff1c798a28e947a56d27e5c3f2d0e33bc34866 && git checkout -B drift-repro f9a1e93f437ac1d9c20042912acfa39bb434d938 && git merge --no-ff 87ff1c798a28e947a56d27e5c3f2d0e33bc34866

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f9a1e93f437ac1d9c20042912acfa39bb434d938
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs f9a1e93f437ac1d9c20042912acfa39bb434d938` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对

ACCEPT · #25681 · `domain:spec` seat 2 (seat post #18549) · `sunhaolin` · session `session_01PC4NPXPgPmpDRG9DdDnyXT` · 2026-10-25T05:47Z · head `87ff1c798a` · report `6394053765` (on #25681; cloud session `session_01T2U7eGg8aRTpJ8kKXxDiog`) · seat review at `TIER_DEFAULT`. The path limb hits (`packages/spec/src/data/**`), so a same-shape `## Contract review` PASS at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` on the landing head is owed. `needs:contract-review` is added in this stroke.

1. **Shape.** Draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #25681`, title `feat(spec,lint):`. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: semantic` and `Ruling-ref: 6386744473` are line-initial in the body and in the changeset (`@objectstack/spec` minor + `@objectstack/lint` minor). 12 files, +369/−14. `check-governed-merges --pr 25755`: NOT governed, 383 lines. The governed half, `skills/**`, is #25741 (Tier H). os-zhuang approved and enqueued it at 05:07–05:09Z. Its text is true on `main` today, so the order of the two merges does not matter.
2. **The ruling, measured on the diff.** Ruling b (「不给对象字段的 `repeater` / `composite` 加子字段声明；明确写下「对象级 … 是无类型 JSON，要带列的列表请建子对象（master_detail）」，并对期望列的 repeater 做 lint/拒收。协议不新增面。」):
   - **No member added.** The `FieldType` comments (`field.zod.ts:95–104`) drop "declared sub-fields" and say untyped JSON, with the child-object route (`master_detail`, `inlineEdit: 'grid'`). `FieldSchema`, the enum and every generated artifact are byte-identical (`check:generated` 14/14 on the pre-merge head).
   - **拒收.** The claim's mechanism lead was confirmed by measurement: the strict `FieldSchema` already refused `fields` / `subFields` / `columns` (and 6 other spellings), but the message named only the key. Three `FIELD_KEY_GUIDANCE` rows now make that refusal name the route. The `columns` row also names the live `lookupColumns` / `relatedListColumns` / `inlineColumns`. This changes the message, not what parses.
   - **lint.** A new rule, `field/embedded-sub-fields` (error), in `lintDataModel`, with an `os explain` entry and a one-line `fix`. Its docblock's intake table is honest: it reaches only the unparsed doors (`os lint` on a raw config, `defineStack(x, { strict: false })`, which was measured to keep the key, and the metadata-generation rubric). This is the `security-owd-alias` posture.
   - **Docs.** `field-types.mdx` gains the sentence and a child-object example. `validation-rules.mdx` loses the false sentence. `layout-dsl.mdx` now says a form field's `fields` list is the form's.
   - **Untouched.** A form view's `fields` sub-rows, `field.form.ts`, objectui.
3. **`Clause-②: no` holds.** Every parse door already refused these keys, so nothing that published before is refused now. The only new refusal is a lint finding on doors that never parse, which is the "lint" half of the ruling's 「lint/拒收」. `Metadata-protocol: semantic` (the meaning of two types is now stated, the message changes) → minor, which is correct. The contract review judges this independently.
4. **Producers.**
   - **This repo:** only `field-zoo.object.ts:166–167`, with no sub-field key.
   - **HotCRM** `a4b3560`: 0 object fields of either type.
   - **objectui** `a3c0da9`: `packages/fields/src/index.tsx:3625` already says the spec has no sub-field member.
   - No producer is refused that was not already refused.
5. **Gates.** On `87ff1c79` (with `origin/main` `5cf1b9d2` merged):
   - spec `test`: 720/721. The 23 failures are all `check-liveness.test.ts`, the main red that #25751 fixes.
   - spec `test:repo`: 79/79.
   - lint: 162/162 (7301 tests).
   - cli unit + integration: 501 files / 6297 tests.
   - typecheck: spec, lint and cli all exit 0.
   - Derived families: 111/111 run, 110 exit 0. The 1 exit 1 is `check:liveness` (main red).
   - On the pre-merge head `22414cf1`: all green, 721/721.
   - **Ablations, predicted then observed, each restored blob-identical:**
     - A (the R14 guard off): 11 red / 13 green.
     - B (the `fields` guidance row deleted): 2 red / 19 green.
6. **Open questions.**
   - (1) Guidance rows on the parse refusal. **A**: this is the ruling's 拒收 half at the doors AI authors actually use (`defineStack`), it changes a message only, and it feeds the existing channel.
   - (2) The lint arm lives in `lintDataModel`. **A**: every registry door parses first, so a registry entry would be a dead second voice.
   - (3) `record` (ADR-0007). **A**: left as ruled. The ruling names only `composite` / `repeater`, and the silence is pinned.
7. **Deviations accepted.**
   - The file surface grew within the claimed container: `authoring-key-lint.ts`, lint `index.ts` / `rule-explanations.ts`, and two docs pages this ruling made false or ambiguous.
   - Model-free trailers.
   - The HotCRM read went through the anonymous git lane after the session classifier refused `add_repo`.
   - `mcp_calls` 4, all reads. Relay writes 3.
8. **Landing.** Not governed. Once #25751 (the main-red fix) is in `main`, the seat brings main in through the relay (`pr_update_branch`). The `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review runs on that landing head. On PASS with every check green, the seat sends `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` through the relay.
